# texture

Benchmarks of [`ordito.texture`](../api/ordito/texture.md) against every library that computes the same thing. Each chart shows the time of every library relative to ordito on CUDA (1x, in green): a longer bar took longer. The table under each chart lists every input the function was measured on. See [Benchmarks](index.md) for how to read and reproduce these numbers.

*Measured on GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 · CPU: Intel Xeon w7-2495X*

## Without a reference

No other library computes these, so they have no comparison. ordito (CUDA)'s median time on the largest input it was measured on:

| Function | Input | ordito (CUDA) |
|---|---|---|
| `rasterize_discrete_attribute` | lucy resolution=2048 | 1.09 ms |
| `remap_attribute_from_uv_linear` | lucy | 247.2 µs |
| `remap_attribute_from_uv_nearest` | lucy | 254.6 µs |
| `remap_discrete_attribute_from_uv` | lucy | 145.9 µs |
| `rasterize_face_indices` | lucy prioritized=True resolution=2048 | 1.64 ms |
